chapters.title: 开场：两条路线
chapters.text: What's up folks, I'm gonna try something different today. I'm gonna build an MCP server in five prompts. I'm gonna make these prompts available to you so you can follow along. And we're hopefully gonna learn a little bit of something about MCP servers, but also how to do AI assisted development.
